tips.text: Do one to a few rounds, extract, and re-queue; enemy level resets but your drop chance never improves with depth.
Kill all four Demolysts every round; a lost conduit is a roll you paid mission time for and never took.
Walk over each Demolyst corpse or bring Vacuum or Fetch, and ask your squad to mark drops; the blueprint never shows on the reward screen.
Run Ur for its Neo relics and let the blueprint fall out; many players got it without ever farming for it.
Bring Heat or Slash damage, not Viral; Demolysts at Ur are immune to Viral, and Cold slows them.
Rely on raw weapon damage and attack in the window after a Demolyst's nullifier pulse, which strips your buffs.
Run it solo if you like; a squad buys speed, not extra drop rolls.
Skip Ur when farming Gauss; his parts drop on Kappa, Sedna, not here.
Clear any Lich or Sister from the mission before the Demolysts die; one can steal the blueprint.
Treat Ur as a relic farm, not a dedicated grind; players who sat in one long run regret it.
